gates.title: Repo guardrail tests failing (brand name, licences)
flow() tests passing: the 12 contract tests in conservation.test.js plus at least 5 of your own in flow*.test.js, none skipped

also.why: skipped flow tests do not count; flow.js must exist

gates.title: flow() on a full A3 page (5 columns, 2 photos, 416 lines of real copy), median ms over 20 runs after 5 warm-up, headless Chromium

also.why: a broken flow() that places nothing must not pass by being fast

gates.title: Exported PDF matches flow(): max left-edge error in pt over every line, by raster (GG-042), plus baseline, justified right edge, font embedding and a mutation check

also.why: every line's PDF baseline sits the same distance below its flow() line top

justified right edges at the 95th percentile, measured by raster: rightmost ink of each line in the rendered PDF vs where its last word's ink should end (pdf.js text widths misreport conjuncts such as ष्ट); see pdfRightMaxPt for the worst line
worst justified line, by raster: one line shifted 0.3 pt or drawn short passes the 95th percentile but not this (negative control, D-031); 0.054 pt on 2026-10-30
a missing font prints in a substitute or fails at the printer
guard: a PDF with no fonts found must not pass the embedding checks
guard: every flow() line must be found in the PDF
guard: the raster left-edge check must cover nearly every line (100% on 2026-10-31)

mutation check: the page printed again with one line drawn 8 pt right must read as that line 8 pt off (within 0.1 pt) and every other line within 0.1 pt; a left-edge measure that cannot see a shift fails the gate (7.991 pt read on 2026-10-31)
guard: the raster right-edge check must cover nearly every justified line (100% on 2026-10-30)
